integrity: The result uses existing first-passage renewal transforms; the claimed contribution is the new global strict-log-concavity and reset-distance crossover-count classification. Separate algebraic and high-precision moment checks corroborate the analytic proof. Publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional unbiased Brownian diffusion with a deterministic initial distance and one positive fixed Poisson reset distance
Poisson resetting, absorbing origin, positive rate and diffusion constant; the theorem does not cover arbitrary distributions, non-Poisson reset clocks, drift or finite-time truncation
Displayed numerical thresholds are approximations, while the exact phase classification is analytic
title: A sharp reset-distance threshold for reentrant first-passage fluctuations
